name: government-watchdog-website
description: Government Watchdog frontend — isolated Alpine Free preview and private-beta civic research lanes.

scripts.build:sites-public: node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs --clean && node scripts/check-no-direct-exposure.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode public --outDir ../dist/client && node scripts/check-no-direct-exposure.mjs --emitted dist/client && node scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs --package --sites-client && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build:public && npm run build:private-beta
scripts.build:private-beta: node scripts/check-no-direct-exposure.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode private-beta && node scripts/check-no-direct-exposure.mjs --emitted dist/client && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.build:public: node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs --clean && node scripts/check-no-direct-exposure.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode public && node scripts/check-no-direct-exposure.mjs --emitted dist/public && node scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs --package
scripts.build:integrated: npm run fetch:artifact && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs --clean && npm run build:private-beta
